conventions: Formatting uses Prettier with @backstage/cli/config/prettier (single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indentation); run Prettier only on changed files.
New source files must start with the standard 15-line Apache 2.0 license header with Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors; existing files must keep their original copyright year.
Never modify ESLint, Prettier, or TypeScript configuration files (.eslintrc.js, tsconfig.json, .prettierignore).
Never manually edit yarn.lock, workspaces/ui/yarn.lock, or packages/test-utils/report.api.md; update lockfiles only via yarn install and API reports only via yarn build:api-reports.
Changeset files in .changeset/*.md are authored directly in plain adopter-facing language without internal symbol names (never mention HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT, hasReactDomClient, or checkReactVersion).

Breaking changes (narrowing React peerDependencies to ^18.0.0 and removing LegacyRootOption/legacyRoot) use minor for packages below 1.0.0 and major for packages at 1.0.0 or above; private packages are excluded from changesets.

decisions.topic: Peer dependency range target and repo-tools enforcement
decisions.choice: Set react, react-dom, and @types/react peerDependencies to ^18.0.0 across all 56 workspace manifests and make ^18.0.0 the sole default in packages/repo-tools/src/commands/peer-deps/peer-deps.ts by removing peerDependenciesReact18Only and react18OnlyPackages
decisions.reason: All Backstage packages now require React 18+, matching the existing ^18.0.0 peer range used by @backstage/ui.

decisions.choice: Import useSyncExternalStore from react in useRouteRef.tsx and useBreakpoint.ts and remove use-sync-external-store and @types/use-sync-external-store from packages/frontend-plugin-api/package.json, packages/ui/package.json, and plugins/app/package.json
decisions.reason: useSyncExternalStore is built into React 18, making the React 17 compatibility shim package redundant.

decisions.topic: Root rendering in dev-utils, frontend-dev-utils, and techdocs
decisions.choice: Use react-dom/client createRoot unconditionally without process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT checks or ReactDOM.render fallbacks
decisions.reason: React 18 always provides react-dom/client and createRoot.

decisions.topic: CLI bundler flag and React version diagnostics
decisions.choice: Remove process.env.HAS_REACT_DOM_CLIENT from bundler/config.ts and cli-module-test-jest/config/jest.js, remove hasReactDomClient.ts, and update startFrontend.ts and bundler/server.ts diagnostics to state React 18 as the minimum required version
decisions.reason: The bundler env flag existed solely for React 17 conditional imports, and CLI diagnostics must reflect the React 18 minimum requirement.

decisions.choice: Import useId from react instead of react-aria in Popover.tsx, Tooltip.tsx, Table.tsx, and TablePagination.tsx

decisions.topic: Removal of LegacyRootOption and legacyRoot in @backstage/test-utils
decisions.choice: Remove LegacyRootOption type and legacyRoot option forwarding from testingLibrary.ts and appWrappers.tsx and regenerate packages/test-utils/report.api.md
rejected: Keep LegacyRootOption as a deprecated no-op type
decisions.reason: Approved at Gate 0 as a major breaking change for @backstage/test-utils with migration guidance in its changeset.

decisions.choice: Create new .changeset/*.md files covering all affected non-private packages with minor (<1.0.0) or major (>=1.0.0) bumps since existing .changeset/*.md files are already recorded in .changeset/pre.json
rejected: Modify existing changesets already consumed in .changeset/pre.json
decisions.reason: Changesets listed in .changeset/pre.json have already been applied in pre-release mode, so new changesets are required to version affected packages.

project_checks.run: CI=true yarn test packages/core-app-api packages/test-utils packages/frontend-test-utils
